rules.label: "cock"

rules.label: "johnson"
rules.description: Contains 'johnson', classic slang (e.g., Bob Johnson, Tom Johnson)

rules.label: "peter"
rules.description: Contains 'peter', classic slang (e.g., Peter DeBoer, Peter Laviolette, Peter Horachek, Bill Peters)
